Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties: the deviation gate fails and the fare already charged stands. The governing distance is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02819, which measures 3.96 km; the booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-02819 is 3.2 km. The excess is therefore 0.76 km, or 23.75% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass: the excess must be greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The percentage limb passes (23.75% > 20%), but the absolute limb fails (0.76 km is not greater than 0.8 km). The trace figure governs and the trip record's rounded 4.0 km may not be used for the threshold test; even that figure gives exactly 0.80 km, which likewise is not greater than 0.80 km. No deviation is established, and POL-RD-01 directs the outcome NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The SGD 9.64 charged on EV-FARE-02819 stands and the SGD 1.50 the rider contests is not returned. This is not a win for either side on the merits of the route; it is the threshold doing its job.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

To both parties: this case turns on a single arithmetic gate in POL-RD-01, and it fails by 40 metres. MEASUREMENT. The governing distance is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02819, at trace_distance_km 3.96 km — not the rounded 4.00 km convenience copy on the trip record, because POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs where the two disagree and the rounded copy may not be cited for the threshold test. The booked optimal route is 3.20 km (EV-TRIP-02819, optimal_distance_km). Excess = 3.96 − 3.20 = 0.76 km, which is 23.75% of optimal. THE GATE. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute. The percentage limb passes (23.75%). The absolute limb fails: 0.76 km is not greater than 0.80 km. Because both limbs must pass, no deviation exists on this trip and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. The rider advocate's concession to precisely this effect is accepted, and the rider is right that the two distance fields straddle the threshold — the policy resolves that straddle against the rule the rider seeks. The driver advocate's threshold claims are accepted for the same reason: even on the rounded 4.00 km copy the excess is exactly 0.80 km, which still does not exceed 0.80 km, so the result is identical whichever field is read. POL-RD-02 does not run: there is no established deviation against which to recompute the fare, so the recomputed figure of 8.68 and the 0.96 difference against the charged total of 9.64 are not reached and are not paid. EV-GPS-02819 is not impaired for policy purposes: 100.0% coverage, 45 fixes at a 10-second interval against a 10-second expected interval, zero gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0 — none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met. The POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is therefore not engaged and no independent corroboration is demanded. THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXPLANATION. The driver's account ('One-way streets') is moot rather than decisive: there is no established deviation for it to excuse, and it supplied no adjusted optimal. OTHER ROUTES CHECKED AND CLOSED. POL-RD-09: EV-FARE-02819 shows erp_lines totalling 0.00 with no gantries, tolls_erp 0.0, airport_surcharge 0.0, waiting_time_fee 0.0 and surge_multiplier 1.0; there is no off-route or phantom gantry, no wrongly applied surcharge and no billing-integrity finding, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral. POL-RD-08: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 with 1 substantiated (below the 4-or-more / 1-or-fewer trigger), so no extra corroboration is demanded — but the rider's initial burden still requires an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, and none exists. Only the profile fields that POL-GEN-01 names were used; every other profile field on either side is context only. ESCALATION CHECKED.
